maxStrikes.label: Max warnings before ban
maxStrikes.helpText: Number of warnings before auto-ban triggers. Default: 3.

banDuration.label: Ban duration (days)
banDuration.helpText: How many days to ban the user. 0 = permanent ban.

rules.label: Subreddit rules (one per line)
rules.helpText: These appear as selectable options when issuing a warning.

warningMessage.label: Custom warning message template
warningMessage.helpText: Leave blank to use the default message. Available placeholders: {username}, {subreddit}, {ruleName}, {strikeNumber}, {maxStrikes}.

notifyModmail.label: Notify mod team via modmail on auto-ban
notifyModmail.helpText: Send a modmail to the subreddit when a user is auto-banned.
